description: Every version here is an exact pin: `=` requirements in Cargo.toml with Cargo.lock committed, exact tools in mise.toml, digests on images and actions. This is the named path for moving a pin: a PR per update, no automerge. Renovate itself is AGPL-3.0; as a hosted app it never enters the dependency graph cargo-deny reads.

customManagers.description: The PostgreSQL image the wall starts (scripts/_db.mjs).

packageRules.description: The workspace rust-version follows rust-toolchain.toml; both move in one PR.
A minor move of a 0.x crate is a breaking change, and a major move of the pinned stack is a deliberate commit with a recorded source and date, not a bot PR.
